controlled_scenarios.prompt: Verify the narrow fact that the v2 contract file parses as JSON.
Verify a bounded task while an unrelated tracked hunk and an untracked file are present.
controlled_scenarios.setup: Create two tracked hunks in one file plus one untracked artifact; only one hunk belongs to the task.
expected: every runtime Hunk/Candidate ID classified exactly once

controlled_scenarios.prompt: Confirm a Claim Boundary, change a relevant byte, then attempt to recapture it.
controlled_scenarios.setup: Use a temporary Git fixture and mutate one included hunk after confirm.

controlled_scenarios.prompt: Review a task whose required changes span two linked worktrees.
controlled_scenarios.setup: Create two linked worktrees with one candidate in each.
expected: Review Record distinguishes child and integration state
risk-based inspection covers every candidate without a full inventory or diff dump

controlled_scenarios.prompt: Pause after an expensive observation and prepare a resumable handoff.
controlled_scenarios.setup: Use a task with a supplied Outcome Reference and one expensive development observation.
expected: resume order reconciles outcome before state
development evidence is not promoted to claim evidence

direct_entry_scenarios.prompt: Use $branch-sandbox to decide whether this one-file documentation edit needs isolation and return its boundary decision.
Use $feedback-loop to choose a focused signal for a reported JSON parsing regression.
Use $grill to resolve the one consequential compatibility ambiguity in this migration request.
Use $plan-lite to turn this accepted two-slice change into a compact implementation plan.
Use $spec-lite to capture this converged API behavior as a lightweight outcome contract.
Use $two-axis-review to review the actual dirty task state on both axes.
Use $verify-before-claim to verify only that contracts/usable-loop-v2.json parses as JSON.
